title: South African Markets - Factors to watch on Jan. 9 By Reuters
text:
© Reuters. South African Markets - Factors to watch on Jan. 9 The following company announcements, scheduled economic indicators, debt and currency market moves and political events may affect South African markets on Wednesday.
SOUTH AFRICAN MARKETS
The South African rand weakened on Tuesday, eating into strong gains since the start of the year as the dollar recovered following a recent slump.
On the bourse, the benchmark JSE Top-40 index .JTOPI ended 0.5 percent higher at 46,116 while the broader All-share index .JALSH gained 0.6 percent to 52,165. .J ZAR/
GLOBAL MARKETS
Asian shares climbed to a 3-1/2-week high on Wednesday, supported by growing optimism that the United States and China can strike a trade deal to avoid an all-out confrontation that would severely disrupt the global economy. MKTS/GLOB
WALL STREET
The S&P 500 jumped to a three-week high on Tuesday, led by Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL ), Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN ), Facebook (NASDAQ: FB ) and industrial shares on bets that the United States and China would strike a deal to end their trade war. .N
GOLD XAU=
Gold prices held steady on Wednesday as a potential close to a months-long Sino-U.S. trade war lifted risk sentiment, countering expectations that the Fed would pause interest rate increases for this year.
